content.text: Home Our Speakers Brad Underwood NEW EXCLUSIVE Head Coach, University of Illinois Fighting Illini Men's Basketball Won the Big Ten Tournament in 2024, Becoming the First Illinois Coach to Win Multiple Big Ten Tournaments Named Southland Conference Coach of the Year Led Illinois to the Elite Eight in 2024 NCAA Tournament Brad Underwood has reinvigorated Illinois basketball, transforming the Fighting Illini into a consistent national contender since arriving in Champaign in March 2017. In 2024, Underwood led Illinois to historic heights, capturing the Big Ten Tournament Championship and advancing to the Elite Eight, becoming the first coach in Illinois history to win multiple Big Ten Tournament titles with the program hoisting a conference trophy for the third time in just four years. Over his 11 years as a Division I head coach, he has compiled an impressive 69% winning percentage, recorded nine 20-win seasons, and made eight NCAA Tournament appearances. As a speaker, Underwood offers powerful insights on leadership, resilience, continuous improvement, and building championship cultures—providing actionable lessons for organizations seeking to elevate performance and create environments where individuals and teams thrive under pressure. As the head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini men’s basketball team, BRAD UNDERWOOD has built a reputation for intensity, discipline, and a commitment to excellence. Under his leadership, Illinois has re-emerged as a national contender, winning the 2021 Big Ten Tournament Championship and securing multiple NCAA Tournament appearances. With a coaching journey that includes a remarkable run at Stephen F. Austin, a season at Oklahoma State, and now a dominant presence in the Big Ten, Underwood brings hard-earned lessons on leadership, resilience, and building a winning culture. In his short keynotes and Q and A sessions, Coach Underwood talks to audiences about: The Underwood Coaching Philosophy: What drives his intense, no-nonsense approach to leadership? Building a Winning Culture: How do you establish and maintain high standards in a competitive environment? Lessons in Grit and Resilience: From small-school success to leading a Big Ten powerhouse, how does Underwood navigate challenges? The Role of Defense & Toughness: Why does his system emphasize discipline, physicality, and relentless effort? Developing Elite Talent: Coaching and mentoring players like Ayo Dosunmu and Kofi Cockburn and preparing them for the next level. Translating Sports Leadership Beyond the Court: How do his coaching principles apply to business, teamwork, and personal success? This conversation is a masterclass in leadership, perseverance, and culture-building, drawing from Underwood’s experiences leading programs at Illinois, Oklahoma State, and Stephen F. Austin. Whether you’re an athlete, coach, executive, or entrepreneur, Underwood’s insights will resonate with anyone looking to build a high-performance team, embrace adversity, and create lasting success. BRAD UNDERWOOD’s coaching philosophy is rooted in one core belief: the desire to be better today than you were yesterday. With a focus on constant self-improvement, Underwood has transformed his teams by fostering a culture of growth, both on and off the court. In this dynamic talk, Coach Underwood delves into: The Power of Daily Improvement: Why small, incremental daily steps lead to exponential growth in the long run. Creating a Culture of Relentless Improvement: How does Underwood inspire his players to continually push themselves to be better, both in skill and character? Turning Failure into Fuel for Growth: How does Underwood encourage his team to view every loss and mistake as an opportunity to improve? The Mentality of Elite Performance: What sets the best performers apart from the rest? How does a commitment to being better each day build long-term success? Practical Steps for Personal Growth: How can individuals—whether athletes, entrepreneurs, or leaders—adopt a mindset of continuous improvement and measure progress? This presentation goes beyond basketball to highlight the universal importance of striving to be better every single day. Whether in leadership, business, or personal life, Coach Underwood’s message will inspire you to embrace challenges, enhance your skills, and create a culture of growth and excellence. Resiliency: The Heart of a Champion As the head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini men’s basketball team, BRAD UNDERWOOD has seen firsthand how resilience shapes a team’s character and drives success. Under his leadership, Illinois has overcome adversity, bounced back from setbacks, and turned challenges into opportunities for grow ... As the head coach of the Illinois Fighting Illini men’s basketball team, BRAD UNDERWOOD has seen firsthand how resilience shapes a team’s character and drives success. Under his leadership, Illinois has overcome adversity, bounced back from setbacks, and turned challenges into opportunities for growth. In this presentation, Coach Underwood explores: The Power of Resilience in Leadership: How does resilience fuel a team’s ability to persevere in the face of adversity? Turning Setbacks into Opportunities: What strategies does Underwood use to help his players and staff rebound after defeat? Mental Toughness in High-Stakes Environments: How does a resilient mindset play a role in performance under pressure, both on and off the court? Developing Resilient Teams: What are the key principles to instill in athletes and colleagues to build a culture that thrives in difficult moments? Real-World Applications of Resilience: How can the lessons of resilience in sports be applied to challenges in business, leadership, and personal growth? Coach Underwood’s insights into resiliency not only focus on bouncing back but also on pushing forward with confidence, determination, and grit. This presentation is a blueprint for anyone looking to overcome obstacles and achieve long-term success. Press & Media Biography Brad Underwood has reinvigorated Illinois Basketball, bringing the Fighting Illini back to the national stage and building a championship program during his tenure in Champaign. Underwood is the 18th head coach in Illinois history, hired in March 2017 as the Richmond Family Endowed Men’s Head Basketball Coach. He has won nearly 69 percent of his games during his 11 years as a Division I head coach, recording nine 20-win seasons. Underwood has made eight appearances in the NCAA Tournament, with a ninth precluded by the cancellation of the 2020 postseason due to COVID-19. Illinois hoisted a conference trophy for the third time in four years in 2024, winning the Big Ten Tournament Championship in Minneapolis. Underwood became the first Illinois coach to win multiple Big Ten Tournaments, claiming two in a span of just four years. That followed a runner-up finish during the regular season where the Illini went 14-6 in conference play.
